products.description: Sale of extended service plans (ESPs) and guaranteed asset protection (GAP) products, designed and administered by third parties, to customers purchasing retail vehicles. These plans provide mechanical, cosmetic, and financial protection.

products.name: Vehicle Repair and Service
products.description: Provision of vehicle repair services at CarMax stores and through a network of third-party service providers, including repairs covered by ESPs and routine maintenance for customers.

products.name: Automotive Information and Digital Shopping Tools (Edmunds)
products.description: Provision of online automotive information, vehicle shopping innovations, and digital tools for consumers and dealers through the Edmunds platform, enhancing the digital car buying and selling experience.

products.name: Pasture-Raised Shell Eggs
products.description: Eggs produced by hens raised on family farms with high animal welfare standards, processed and packaged at company-owned facilities using automated grading and packing technology. Offered in various sizes, pack counts, and specialty varieties (e.g., organic, True Blues, Restorative Eggs). Distributed nationally through retail, foodservice, and other channels.

products.name: Butter
products.description: Premium butter made from primarily Irish, 90% grass-fed and pasture-raised cream, imported in bulk and processed by a U.S. co-manufacturer into stick butter. Sold in salted and unsalted varieties and multiple pack sizes through retail and foodservice channels.

products.name: Hard-Boiled Eggs
products.description: Ready-to-eat hard-boiled eggs produced from pasture-raised eggs sourced from the company's network of small farms and processed by a co-manufacturer. Distributed through retail and foodservice channels for convenient snacking and ingredient use.

products.name: Liquid Whole Eggs
products.description: Liquid whole eggs made from pasture-raised eggs, processed by a co-manufacturer for use as a convenient ingredient in cooking and foodservice. One of the only pasture-raised liquid whole egg offerings in the U.S. processed egg market.

products.name: Nutanix Cloud Platform
products.description: A unified software platform enabling organizations to build and manage hybrid multicloud infrastructure, supporting application and data management across private, public, and edge environments. Delivered as software deployed on qualified hardware or as SaaS, it integrates compute, storage, and networking with a consistent cloud operating model.

products.name: Hyperconverged Infrastructure (HCI) Software (Nutanix Cloud Infrastructure, NCI)
products.description: Software that merges compute, storage, and networking resources from clusters of servers into a single logical pool, providing integrated resiliency, security, and simplified administration for enterprise IT applications. Delivered as software for deployment on commodity x86 servers or via OEM hardware partners.

products.name: Enterprise Virtualization and Container Management (Nutanix AHV, Data Services for Kubernetes, NKP)
products.description: Enterprise-grade virtualization and Kubernetes management solutions, including a native hypervisor (AHV) and Kubernetes platform (NKP), enabling secure, resilient operation of virtual machines and containerized workloads across clouds and data centers. Delivered as software integrated into the Nutanix platform.

products.name: Cloud Management and Automation (Nutanix Cloud Manager, NCM)
products.description: Unified management software providing intelligent operations, self-service orchestration, security compliance, and cloud cost governance for hybrid and multicloud environments. Delivered as software or SaaS, it automates operational tasks and optimizes resource usage.

products.name: Software-Defined Storage and Data Services (Nutanix Unified Storage, NUS)
products.description: A software-defined platform consolidating block, file, and object storage management, with integrated analytics, ransomware protection, and lifecycle management. Delivered as software for deployment on qualified hardware or in the cloud, supporting diverse application needs.

products.name: Database Management and Automation (Nutanix Database Service, NDB)
products.description: A database-as-a-service platform automating lifecycle management of diverse database environments across on-premises and public clouds, integrating with cloud native development processes. Delivered as software or SaaS.

products.name: Enterprise AI Infrastructure and Services (Nutanix Enterprise AI, GPT-in-a-Box)
products.description: Centralized AI infrastructure and inferencing control plane, including validated solutions for generative AI workloads, providing secure, resilient, and privacy-focused AI operations across clouds and data centers. Delivered as software and services, supporting a range of hardware accelerators.

products.name: Professional Services (Consulting and Implementation)
products.description: Consulting and implementation services for assessment, design, deployment, and optimization of Nutanix environments, delivered by in-person or remote human experts.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides secured and unsecured loans to businesses, including revolving lines of credit, term loans, equipment financing, sponsor finance, and healthcare lending. Loans are originated primarily through in-person relationship banking and require significant underwriting, collateral, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Offers loans secured by commercial real estate properties, including owner-occupied, investor, retail, industrial, office, hotel, mixed-use, and healthcare properties. Loans are originated and serviced through physical branches and require property appraisals, collateral, and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Originates and services residential mortgage loans, including conventional, government, and jumbo loans, as well as home equity lines of credit. Loans are produced through branch and digital channels, with some sold to secondary market investors and others held in portfolio.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provides a variety of consumer loans, including motor vehicle, home improvement, manufactured home, solar, and signature loans. Loans are originated through branches and third-party channels, requiring credit underwriting and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Powersport Lending
products.description: Finances the purchase of recreational vehicles such as motorcycles, ATVs, UTVs, snowmobiles, and personal watercraft through a nationwide network of third-party dealers. Loans are originated digitally and through dealer relationships, with risk-based pricing and monitoring.

products.name: Leasing and Equipment Finance
products.description: Provides lease financing for business equipment to small and mid-size businesses, including investment grade leases. Leases are originated through direct relationships and require collateral, underwriting, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Deposit Products and Services
products.description: Offers a full range of deposit accounts and related services for consumers and businesses, including checking, savings, money market, time deposits, and retirement accounts. Delivered through physical branches, digital channels, and ATMs, with competitive rates and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Wealth Management and Trust Services
products.description: Provides wealth management, investment advisory, agency, and custodial services for individuals, corporations, and not-for-profits, including estate and trust administration and investment account management. Services are delivered through dedicated teams and require regulatory oversight.

products.name: Electronic Banking and Cash Management Services
products.description: Offers digital banking services such as online and mobile banking, remote deposit capture, investment sweep accounts, ACH transactions, wire transfers, lockbox, and corporate cash management products. Services are delivered via digital platforms and require secure technology infrastructure.

products.name: Electric Air Taxi Aircraft (Midnight)
products.description: A proprietary electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft designed and manufactured for urban air taxi operations, carrying four passengers plus a pilot, optimized for short, high-frequency trips. Delivered through physical manufacturing, regulatory certification, and integration with air taxi networks.

products.name: Air Taxi Services
products.description: Direct-to-consumer urban air mobility (UAM) services using company-owned eVTOL aircraft, providing short-distance passenger flights in metropolitan areas. Delivered via in-person human labor, regulated infrastructure, and digital booking platforms.

products.name: Dual-Use Hybrid-Electric VTOL Aircraft (Cargo and Defense)
products.description: Hybrid-electric, autonomous vertical take-off and landing (VTOL) aircraft platform developed for both defense and commercial customers, tailored for cargo transport and medical evacuation. Requires physical manufacturing, advanced propulsion, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Advanced Aviation Technologies (Propulsion, Flight Control, Autonomy)
products.description: Proprietary electric and hybrid propulsion systems, flight control software, and AI/autonomy technologies developed for integration into Archer and third-party aircraft. Delivered as technology components or licensing to external customers, including defense contractors.

products.name: Aircraft Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) Services
products.description: Maintenance, repair, and overhaul services for Archer aircraft, provided through certified repair stations. Delivered via in-person technical labor and regulated facilities.

products.name: Pilot Training Services
products.description: Training and qualification services for pilots operating Archer aircraft, provided through a certified training academy. Delivered via in-person instruction and regulated curriculum.

products.name: Legal Finance Capital Provision
products.description: Provision of capital to businesses and law firms engaged in large, complex legal disputes, including single-case and portfolio financing, monetization of expected future value of claims, and upfront cash payments. Delivered through direct investment, typically with bespoke contractual terms, and requires significant financial capital and legal underwriting expertise.

products.name: Legal Risk Management and Adverse Cost Insurance
products.description: Provision of insurance products to protect clients against adverse litigation outcomes, such as being held liable for opponents' legal costs, primarily through a licensed insurer. Requires regulated insurance infrastructure and underwriting expertise.

products.name: Legal Asset Management Services
products.description: Management of private funds and investment vehicles focused on legal finance assets on behalf of third-party investors, including sovereign wealth funds and institutional clients. Delivered as an SEC-registered investment adviser, generating fee income from fund management.

products.name: Judgment Enforcement Services
products.description: Provision of services to assist clients in enforcing judgments and awards from funded disputes, leveraging business intelligence and legal expertise. Delivered through specialized teams and acquired business intelligence capabilities.

products.name: Post-Settlement Legal Receivables Monetization
products.description: Purchase and monetization of post-settlement and other legal receivables where litigation risk is minimal, offering clients upfront cash and targeting returns similar to fixed income investments. Funded primarily through private funds managed for third-party investors.
